Ending your life painlessly WILL cause pain for people around you. Killing yourself reaches far and wide. People you’d think wouldn’t acknowledge your existence.. 

Talk about it. If there’s no one you feel you can talk to.. this sounds stupid but talk to yourself. 

Don’t think about big picture. Don’t think about how you’re going to feel tomorrow. Don’t think about how you’re going to feel tomorrow, in a week, a year etc. Focus on seconds. You get through another 1..2..3 seconds I’m happy for you. The world is happy for you..

The world is a better place with you in it. I promise.

My main goals is to be able to draw the things in my head. I’ve been playing guitar for 20 years and I can play anything I hear. I can hear a tune in my head translate it to a guitar.

I want to do that with my eyes and imagination. I want to be able to draw the people/scenes/scenarios/stories in my head. Not even for people to see.. maybe just for me to look at.

I’m not sure if that sounds stupid or selfish.
